summary: V031_RELEASE_READY: BLOCKED — the bounded authoritative DSH cohort audit, real candidate npm install, frozen install, client build, package audits, publish dry-run, public absence checks, and conservative branch cleanup passed. The required full deterministic sweep remains blocked by one pre-existing distribution test failure: the test requires legacy README npm/profile wording that the task's pre-existing simplified README no longer contains, and both README files plus unrelated test fixes are forbidden here.

tests.name: T01 Task Contract, source revision, and clean main baseline
tests.evidence: The task validator returned VALID TASK CONTRACT. After checkout and pull --ff-only, main was clean at exact source commit 1bfef5106ce2c5c03e40985b0e77eb4525f612df and matched origin/main.

tests.name: T02 Bounded cohort audit regression coverage
tests.evidence: node --test test/verify-npm-install.test.mjs exited 0 with 4 passed and 0 failed. Tests cover exact/caret cohort evaluation, authoritative-manifest PASS, missing-manifest fail-closed behavior, and incompatible cross-cohort range fail-closed behavior using injected deterministic manifests without network, credentials, or official DSH state.

tests.name: T03 Frozen dependency installation
tests.evidence: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile exited 0 with the lockfile already up to date; no pnpm-lock.yaml change was produced.

tests.name: T04 Candidate default npm install gate
tests.evidence: pnpm run verify:npm-install returned NPM_INSTALL_CONTRACT=PASS candidate=0.3.1 official_dsh=not-run. The packed candidate was materially installed with npm's normal resolver and no peer-resolution bypass; package/runtime identity and required entries were verified.

tests.name: T05 Bounded official DSH cohort manifest audit
tests.evidence: pnpm run verify:npm-install:official returned DSH_COHORT_AUDIT=PASS official_dsh=0.1.1-rc.2 direct_peers=20 manifests=21 cross_cohort_checks=177 and NPM_INSTALL_CONTRACT=PASS candidate=0.3.1 official_dsh=0.1.1-rc.2:manifest-audit. It fetched only the official manifest plus the 20 direct Crew DSH peer manifests, validated exact identity/cohort presence, and checked all relevant DSH dependency/optional/peer ranges without full host resolution or materialization.

tests.name: T06 Full deterministic test sweep
tests.evidence: node --test test/*.test.mjs completed with 430 tests, 429 passed, 1 failed. The sole failure is test/distribution.test.mjs: its primary documentation assertion still requires the legacy regex npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add github:Ran-sh/dsh-crew, but the task's pre-existing simplified README no longer contains that text. The targeted distribution test reproduced 2 passed and 1 failed. README.md, README.zh.md, and unrelated test changes are forbidden by this task, so the failure was not altered or relabeled.

tests.name: T07 Client build and generated-artifact cleanup
tests.evidence: pnpm run build:client exited 0 and built lib/client.js. The deterministic tracked build side effect was restored, leaving no lib/client.js product diff.

tests.name: T08 npm pack dry-run and payload audit
tests.evidence: npm pack --dry-run --json reported @ran-sh/dsh-crew@0.3.1, 86 files, unpacked size 1,595,588 bytes, tarball size 884,947 bytes, and integrity metadata. The audit found no ACTIVE task/result, temporary, secret, credential, node_modules, or test-only payload entries.

tests.name: T09 Non-publishing npm publish dry-run
tests.evidence: npm publish --dry-run --access public exited 0 for @ran-sh/dsh-crew@0.3.1 from the prepared candidate state. No registry mutation occurred.

tests.name: T10 Public candidate/tag/Release absence
tests.evidence: The public npm packument returned HTTP 200 with dist-tags.latest=0.3.0 and no 0.3.1 version; git ls-remote found no remote refs/tags/v0.3.1; the public GitHub Releases API returned HTTP 404 for v0.3.1.

tests.name: T11 Conservative branch classification and open-PR safety
tests.evidence: After fetch --prune, all 12 remaining remote non-main branches and 10 local non-main branches were classified with ancestry and git cherry results. GitHub PR #15 was verified closed without mergedAt, PR #34 was verified merged with non-null mergedAt and explicitly superseding #15, and the immediate pre-deletion open-PR count was 0.

tests.name: T12 Branch cleanup and final ref safety
tests.evidence: Only remote feat/v0.3-model-selection-trace was deleted by normal git push origin --delete, using PR #15 supersession by merged PR #34 plus no still-needed unique code as proof. No local branch was deleted because no local counterpart existed and all other local branches retained unique work. After fetch --prune, 11 remote non-main and 10 local non-main branches remained; origin/main stayed 1bfef5106ce2c5c03e40985b0e77eb4525f612df, open PR count remained 0, and the tag inventory was not mutated.

tests.name: T13 Final diff and scope hygiene
tests.evidence: git diff --check passed. Before Result Contract assembly the worktree contained only the authorized scripts/verify-npm-install.mjs and test/verify-npm-install.test.mjs changes; package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, README files, product runtime files, tags, Releases, credentials, and official DSH state were untouched.

blockers: The required full deterministic sweep has one pre-existing failure in test/distribution.test.mjs because it asserts legacy README text that the task's pre-existing simplified README.md no longer contains. This task forbids README.md, README.zh.md, and unrelated test changes, so the full required gate cannot be proven PASS and the release verdict must remain BLOCKED.
